name: Capitol Hill
description: Follow Capitol Hill, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Mitch McConnell returns to Capitol Hill after monthslong absence
changes.summary: GOP Sen. Mitch McConnell of Kentucky returned to Capitol Hill on Monday for the first time in three months, ending a prolonged absence that sparked widespread speculation about his health.

changes.title: House Speaker Mike Johnson says Trump's $5,000 'dividend' needs congressional approval
changes.summary: Trump made the unusual pitch at the party's midterm convention in Dallas last week, promising a "Trump Dividend" if voters keep the GOP in power on Capitol Hill.
